scope: Normal launcher journey using the exact unmodified German FireRed ROM, two real emulator cores, isolated profiles and virtual SDL gamepads

public_save_sources.description: English early save with Bulbasaur and Rattata, curated complete Pokédex and full PC collection
Japanese early save with Squirtle, curated complete Pokédex and full PC collection
English late save with eight badges and an existing six-Pokémon team

early_world_and_battle.method: Existing public-save positions, parties, flags and inventory; all subsequent movement, menu choices, encounters and saving performed through launcher input. No map teleport or authored party/encounter in this journey.

late_story_pair.method: Early English public save plus eight-badge public save, entered normally via the production launcher; no map placement edits in this test

known_defects.evidence: Natural launcher fight displayed two enemies. A separate authored one-enemy native scenario observed both opponent battlers active with party indexes [0,0] and absent flags 0.
known_defects.effect: The duplication affects battle logic as well as display; single-opponent co-op is not certified.

known_defects.evidence: Player two selected and spent their own ball and received the Pokémon, but the native message named player one as using the ball.

targeted_native_regressions: own party menu cancel and import

limitations: Not a continuous campaign or postgame run
Public curated saves are not proof of cross-language compatibility
Real gamepads, audible output, Windows and Bazzite were unavailable on this host
The published Alpha 8 release does not include this development worker
Other campaign, experience-sharing and partner-world limitations remain in the existing runtime report
source_material_excluded: No ROM, battery save, checkpoint or gameplay screenshot is included in this report or repository.

fixed_defects.prior_behavior: Two human escape selections in a natural wild battle displayed an impossible-escape message; the original routine skips the speed calculation in doubles.
fixed_defects.change: The experimental worker lets the original speed/RNG escape calculation run for human battlers in reviewed wild encounters, without changing the global battle flags or trainer/link behavior.

fixed_defects.prior_behavior: A natural shared rival win and equal reward left the guest at the pre-battle scene stage without their own rival receipt.
fixed_defects.change: Synchronize the guest only when the source has both the original rival win receipt and the completed native scene stage, selecting the guest rival variant from the guest starter.

natural_route22_rival.method: From existing early saves, both entered the Pokémon Center and healed normally, walked to Route 22, and player one triggered the original rival scene without a teleport or authored party.
